findings.description: A Historic Preservation Commission agenda item considered a recommendation to designate the Transamerica Pyramid at 600 Montgomery Street as an Article 10 Landmark under Planning Code Section 1004.2; the article says final approval has not been established.

extra.process: Historic Preservation Commission recommendation toward Article 10 designation; Board of Supervisors agenda document also cited

citation.label: Hoodline, “Transamerica Pyramid Could Become SF Landmark, Benches and All,” 12 November 2026

raw.text: A San Francisco Historic Preservation Commission agenda item considered a recommendation to designate the tower at 600 Montgomery Street, known as the Transamerica Pyramid, as an Article 10 Landmark under Section 1004.2

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 600 MONTGOMERY ST → parcel 0207032; sf-parcels has blklot 0207032 active, 600–600 MONTGOMERY; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1971.

publish.note: Entry on the existing page /san-francisco/chinatown/montgomery-street/600/ (hoodline-2026-11-12) and card on the homepage grid. A recommendation, not a designation: historic_status is unchanged and nothing goes in building, which already names the tower and its architect.
